Blood Frenzy.name: Blood Frenzy
Blood Frenzy.desc: Increase the production of all Evil buildings for its duration.

Brainwave.name: Brainwave
Brainwave.desc: Increase the production of all buildings by a cumulative percentage per second, based on time passed.

Call to Arms.name: Call to Arms
Call to Arms.desc: Increase the production of all buildings based on buildings built.

Combo Strike.name: Combo Strike
Combo Strike.desc: Increase the production of all buildings by a progressively higher value as you continue casting this spell. The duration of the spell cannot be modified.

Diamond Pickaxe.name: Diamond Pickaxe
Diamond Pickaxe.desc: Increase clicking reward based on Excavation depth and increase your Faction Coin find chance.

Fairy Chanting.name: Fairy Chanting
Fairy Chanting.desc: Increase the production of Farms, Inns and Blacksmiths based on the amounts built.

Gem Grinder.name: Gem Grinder
Gem Grinder.desc: Multiplicatively increase the production bonus from Gems.

Goblin's Greed.name: Goblin's Greed
Goblin's Greed.desc: Instantly produce Faction Coins based on Gems owned.

God's Hand.name: God's Hand
God's Hand.desc: Increase the production of all buildings based on your Mana Regeneration. The duration increases with time spent as Good in this Reincarnation.

Grand Balance.name: Grand Balance
Grand Balance.desc: Increase the production of your least productive buildings based on the three most built ones.

Hellfire Blast.name: Hellfire Blast
Hellfire Blast.desc: Increase the production of Evil Fortresses and Hell Portals based on your amount of trophies.

Lightning Strike.name: Lightning Strike
Lightning Strike.desc: The production of a random building is increased based on the amount of Iron Strongholds owned.

Moon Blessing.name: Moon Blessing
Moon Blessing.desc: Increase the production of all buildings based on clicks made in this Reincarnation.

Night Time.name: Night Time
Night Time.desc: The production of assistants is increased based on Necropolises owned.

Spiritual Surge.name: Spiritual Surge
Spiritual Surge.desc: Increase the production of all buildings based on Reincarnations made.

Tax Collection.name: Tax Collection
Tax Collection.desc: Instantly gain some seconds' worth of coin production from buildings and assistants.

Hailstorm.name: Hailstorm
Hailstorm.desc: Increase the production of all buildings based on Hailstorm activity time. The bonus increases progressively over the duration of the spell.

Heatwave.name: Heatwave
Heatwave.desc: Increase the production of all buildings based on spells cast in this Era.

Dragon's Breath.name: Dragon's Breath
Dragon's Breath.desc: Activates one of six effects at random: Red, Green, Blue, White, Black or Yellow.

Cannibalize.name: Cannibalize
Cannibalize.desc: Increase Faction Coin find chance based on the total amount of Bones collected and Reincarnations made.

Shadow Embrace.name: Shadow Embrace
Shadow Embrace.desc: Increase the size of your assistant army based on Reincarnations made. Increases progressively as you continue casting this spell.

Wail of the Banshee.name: Wail of the Banshee
Wail of the Banshee.desc: Increase the production of all buildings based on mana produced in this Era and Reincarnations made.

Temporal Flux.name: Temporal Flux
Temporal Flux.desc: Increase the production of Unique Buildings based on time spent in this Era. Multiplicatively increase Mana Regeneration based on time spent in this Era.

All Creation.name: All Creation
All Creation.desc: Increase the production of all buildings based on your Mana Regeneration.

Maelstrom.name: Maelstrom
Maelstrom.desc: Increase the production of two random buildings based on one of these stats in this Era, chosen at random: mana produced, trophies unlocked, Faction Coins found or amount of assistants.

Infinite Spiral.name: Infinite Spiral
Infinite Spiral.desc: Increase the production of all buildings by a percentage each second, up to its maximum duration. Temporarily increase assistants based on Maximum Mana.

Limited Wish.name: Limited Wish
Limited Wish.desc: Provide a random effect based on your chosen alignment. The duration of the spell cannot be modified, but its cost decreases by 1% per minute up to 1 hour, then it resets. Its power increases as you continue casting this spell.

Precognition.name: Precognition
Precognition.desc: Buildings, Assistants, Royal Exchanges, Spells cast and Clicks count more, based on mana produced in this Era.

Catalyst.name: Catalyst
Catalyst.desc: Activates two random Vanilla or base alignment spells.

Chaos Madness.name: Chaos Madness
Chaos Madness.desc: Grants the effect of a random lineage, with the level of your highest lineage.

Feast Offering.name: Feast Offering
Feast Offering.desc: Multiplicatively increase the production bonus from Gems by 1000%.

Twisting Nether.name: Twisting Nether
Twisting Nether.desc: Lineage levels count more for its duration.
